scenario: A delivery truck makes exactly six stops—at Fairview, Greendale, Hillcrest, Ipswich, Jamestown, and Kenwood—one after another, with no two stops occurring at the same time. The order of the stops is consistent with the following conditions: Greendale is the third stop. Fairview is stopped at some time before Hillcrest. Ipswich is stopped at immediately before or immediately after Jamestown. Kenwood is not the first stop and not the last stop.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be the order of the stops, from first to last?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Fairview, Kenwood, Greendale, Ipswich, Jamestown, Hillcrest

choices.label: B
choices.text: Fairview, Hillcrest, Greendale, Ipswich, Jamestown, Kenwood

choices.label: C
choices.text: Kenwood, Fairview, Greendale, Hillcrest, Ipswich, Jamestown

choices.label: D
choices.text: Fairview, Kenwood, Hillcrest, Greendale, Ipswich, Jamestown

choices.label: E
choices.text: Fairview, Jamestown, Greendale, Hillcrest, Kenwood, Ipswich

explanations.correct: Greendale is third, Fairview (1) precedes Hillcrest (6), Ipswich (4) and Jamestown (5) are adjacent, Kenwood (2) is neither first nor last. All rules satisfied.
explanations.B: Kenwood is last, violating the rule that Kenwood is not the last stop. Also Hillcrest precedes Fairview.
explanations.C: Kenwood is first, violating the rule that Kenwood is not the first stop.
explanations.E: Ipswich and Jamestown are not adjacent (positions 6 and 2).

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Greendale is stopped at before Hillcrest.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Kenwood is stopped at before Greendale.

explanations.correct: Greendale is fixed at position 3. Fairview precedes Hillcrest, so Hillcrest cannot be at position 1, 2, or 3 (Greendale holds 3 and Fairview must be earlier than Hillcrest). Therefore Hillcrest is at position 4, 5, or 6—always after Greendale.
explanations.A: Fairview could be second (with Kenwood first).
explanations.B: Hillcrest could be at positions 4, 5, or 6.
explanations.D: Kenwood could be at positions 4 or 5, after Greendale.
explanations.E: Ipswich need not be fourth; it could occupy other positions.

questions.questionStem: If Kenwood is the fifth stop, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: With Greendale at 3 and Kenwood at 5, positions 1, 2, 4, and 6 hold Fairview, Hillcrest, Ipswich, and Jamestown. Ipswich and Jamestown must be adjacent; among {1,2,4,6} the only adjacent pair is {1,2}. So Ipswich and Jamestown fill positions 1 and 2, leaving Fairview and Hillcrest for 4 and 6. Since Fairview precedes Hillcrest, Fairview=4 and Hillcrest=6.
explanations.A: Fairview must be fourth, not first.
explanations.C: Ipswich could be first or second.
explanations.D: Jamestown is first or second, not fourth.

If Kenwood=4, Ipswich and Jamestown fill 5,6 (adjacent ✓). If Kenwood=5, Ipswich and Jamestown fill 4,6 (not adjacent ✗). So Kenwood=4, Ipswich/Jamestown at 5,6. explanations.A: Fairview first is consistent with many solutions.
explanations.B: Hillcrest fourth is achievable (e.g., Fairview=1 or 2, Kenwood=2 or 1, Greendale=3, Hillcrest=4, Ipswich/Jamestown at 5,6).
explanations.C: Jamestown first is achievable with Ipswich second.
explanations.D: Forces Fairview=1, Kenwood=4, Ipswich/Jamestown at 5,6 — impossible because Kenwood adjacent constraint; this selection flagged.

questions.questionStem: If Hillcrest is the fourth stop, then which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: With Greendale=3 and Hillcrest=4, Fairview must be at position 1 or 2. The remaining positions 1, 2, 5, 6 hold Fairview, Ipswich, Jamestown, and Kenwood; Kenwood cannot be at 6. Ipswich and Jamestown must be adjacent: the only adjacent pair among 1,2,5,6 is {1,2} or {5,6}. If I/J are at 5,6, then Fairview and Kenwood are at 1,2; Kenwood can be 1 or 2 (both okay since only position 1 & 6 are forbidden for Kenwood—wait, Kenwood≠1 too). So Kenwood=2, Fairview=1, and Ipswich/Jamestown occupy 5,6. Ipswich at 5 is possible (with Jamestown at 6).
explanations.A: Fairview must be at position 1 or 2, not 5.
